Delhi Traffic Advisory Issued for Independence Day Rehearsal

Delhi Traffic Police issued an advisory for the Independence Day full-dress rehearsal on August 13, implementing traffic restrictions around the Red Fort until 10 AM for security reasons. Commuters were urged to use alternate routes and the metro. Similar advisories were issued for Independence Day celebrations on August 15 in various cities including Dehradun and Jammu, with traffic diversions and security measures in place. Preparations for the 80th Independence Day celebrations at the Red Fort, including security arrangements and metro services, are underway.
